sections.heading: HOD, ME Coordinator,Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design and Technology) Department
sections.content:
Email id: snehal.veer@abmspcoerpune.org
VLSI design and Technology holds both national and international importance due to its technological advancements, economic impact, defense and security applications, energy efficiency contributions, healthcare and biotechnology innovations and its role in research and development. The field continues to evolve, driving progress in various sectors and shaping the future of electronics and technology.
Government of India has allotted a total of Rs. 16,549 crore for the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology with Rs. 3000 crore for semiconductor mission, reflecting cognizance of the accelerated demand for electronics in the post-pandemic era.
Department has Well equipped laboratories, Smart Classroom, Smart Seminar Hall, Highly educated faculties. Large semiconductor companies, such as Intel, Qualcomm, Samsung, Nvidia, AMD, and Texas Instruments, hire VLSI design engineers for various roles, including IC design, verification, physical design and test engineering. EDA companies like Cadence Design Systems, Synopsys, and Mentor Graphics provide software tools for VLSI design and verification. These companies hire VLSI engineers for software development, technical support, and application engineering roles.
Department is having MoU with well-known companies and its very useful for internships, training and placement. Department is also run Post graduate (PG) course with intake 12 in Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design)
